newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai shares fall sharply at noon on rumours.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai shares fall sharply at noon on rumours.

text.p: Shanghai A and B shares fell sharply at midday on Wednesday on rumours that Beijing will take measures to cool down the booming stock markets, brokers said.
The B index lost 5.794 points or 6.21 percent to 87.521 points on volume of 13.99 million shares worth $10.31 million.
The A index shed 64.877 points or 4.24 percent to 1,466.429 points on volume of 346.4 million shares worth 4.96 billion yuan.
Brokers said there were widespread rumours in the market that Beijing would take steps to crack down on the stock markets, which have risen more than 50 percent this year.
One rumour said the central government would allow some institutional shares, which are currently not traded, to be listed, brokers said.
Officials with the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the securities watchdog, have declined to comment.

"The rumours began to circulate on Tuesday and continued to swirl around the market today, severely dampening market sentiment," one broker said. "Institutions, in particular securities brokerages, sold heavily this morning and they were followed by retail investors."
On the B share market, of 43 B shares, 40 traded with 39 down and one up.
Heilongjiang Electric Power Co was the biggest loser on institutional selling, plunging $0.092 or 9.48 percent to $0.878 on volume of 408,000 shares.

Shanghai Worldbest Co was the most actively traded and it fell on heavy profit-taking despite some institutional support, brokers said. The stock fell $0.040 or 5.49 percent to $0.700 on volume of 3.4 million shares.
Brokers said the B share index would test the 87-point support level shortly.
"If the support level is breached, the B market will continue to fall in the short term with sentiment greatly worsened," a second broker said.
On the A share market, the SSE 30 blue-chip index dived 162.356 points or 3.88 percent to 4,020.792 points.
Wuxi Taiji Industry Co was the worst performer on institutional selling, plunging 1.10 yuan to the limit-down level of 9.88 yuan on volume of 6.1 million shares.
